brief: Nomura's McElligott: Iran attacks and bombing-resumption bluster into US midterms are pushing oil and refining cracks higher and lifting rates, yet US equities keep refusing to fall because AI megacap tech is rates-insensitive and absorbing all capital and sentiment. Long Semis + Long Energy is framed as the year's best trade (+65% YTD, 3.2 Sharpe) because it pairs AI-constraint alpha with a built-in rates hedge, since bonds have failed both as longs and as an equity hedge. Index-level SPX vol is stuck near multi-year lows on high dispersion/low correlation even as a rolling correction hits rate-sensitive sectors beneath the surface (85% of S&P names >10% below ATHs). Heavy 0DTE/QIS and structured-note vol supply keeps dealers long gamma/vega, letting vol-control/CTA/risk-parity systematics re-lever to the 86th percentile of exposure; downside-hedge demand is weak while call skew sits at the 99.6th percentile, so the dominant fear is missing a further melt-up, not a selloff. Trade permutations: megacap tech call spreads into an SPX 8k chase; if Trump offers conciliatory Iran deal talk, rotate into Gold and IWM upside as energy/rate vol collapse; otherwise stay hedged long rates vega via swaption straddles, since McElligott believes Trump resumes Iran attacks regardless of the midterm outcome.
